notablePrerequisites: Animar has a +1/+1 counter on it.
easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Bontu's Monument trigger, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.
